title: Arrow of Piercing
summary: A special arrow with a reported piercing-effect bug.

fields.Activation: Action. Consume one arrow and fire a ranged weapon shot up to 60 ft.
fields.Damage: Weapon damage to the initial target. The listed half damage to creatures behind it reportedly lacks implementation.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Woyy at Facemaker’s Boutique.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 mechanics and pinned item and related rule sources.
